title: Classify all fresh-factor links on two fixed binary blocks (no κ)
body:
## Result and scope

This package classifies **every one-link extension of the two fixed binary normal-form blocks when both fresh factors are nonzero**, at arbitrary ambient width. The complete projector pool is irreducible exactly when both core factors use the two hubs and the fresh factors have inner product one. In that case its pattern space is unit-free of dimension five and its joint image has dimension seven.

This resolves the fresh-factor part of the classification question after [PR #7648](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7648). For r fresh coordinates the exact nonsymmetric count is `(2^r-2)*2^(r-1)`: four at width eight. Disjoint fresh supports cannot work. All positive pools have the same action on their joint image. This last conclusion separates a new coordinate support from a new action.

Read the [all-width proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/943c355c233649f77f018e6247e5456584ef715e/research/two-block-fresh-link-classification/PROOF.md), [exact receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/943c355c233649f77f018e6247e5456584ef715e/research/two-block-fresh-link-classification/RESULT.json), [verifier](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/943c355c233649f77f018e6247e5456584ef715e/research/two-block-fresh-link-classification/verify.py) and [scope record](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/943c355c233649f77f018e6247e5456584ef715e/research/two-block-fresh-link-classification/TASK.json). The proof allows arbitrary core support. It handles zero core factors using invariant subspaces of the **complete** pool. Such pools can have eight projectors; the verifier does not assume the displayed seven generators are complete.

**No new kappa**, paid BIT word or selected-assumption discharge is claimed. All five assumptions and [selected PR #7000](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7000) remain unchanged. This completes the [advance claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1166#discussioncomment-19702706) on the changed structural side question of `bit-new-register-model`; that card's original new-alphabet gate remains unmet.

## Evidence and reproduction

Normal and optimized CPython 3.12.16 checks passed on macOS arm64. The verifier enumerates all **40768 rank-one idempotents** at widths seven and eight. All **20605 candidate links** get complete-pool reconstruction by two methods, followed by an invariant-subspace certificate or all nonzero vector orbits. There are one and six irreducible links, with 889 positive census orbit checks. A separate source witness adds 127 orbit checks. The valid disjoint-fresh negative, an eight-projector unit-free degeneracy and five rejection controls pass. These finite checks corroborate the proof; they are not an all-width enumeration.

Package metadata, committed bytes, executable modes, source ancestry, the official seven-file export and its integrity check passed. An optimized replay of the read-only export passed without Git or a usable PATH. All eight payload/manifest hashes and modes stayed unchanged. No external run-time input is used. The proof and README were also rendered with GitHub Markdown and checked.

From the repository root, with CPython 3.12:

```sh
python3.12 -I -W error -B research/two-block-fresh-link-classification/verify.py
python3.12 -I -W error -B -O research/two-block-fresh-link-classification/verify.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/two-block-fresh-link-classification
python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/two-block-fresh-link-classification --check-source-history --check-modes
```

Expected status markers:

```text
PASS_TWO_BLOCK_FRESH_LINK_CLASSIFICATION
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE
PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES
```

Hosted CI is pending; it is not scientific evidence yet. Predecessor scientific replays, the selected cold replay, Lean and Docker were not run. Independent human and formal-kernel review are unclaimed.

## Credit and remaining obligations

Prepared by @aliromman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Nick Petalas (@petalas) supplied the nonsymmetric witness and classification question in [PR #7648](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7648), [exact source](https://github.com/petalas/integer-mult-bounds/blob/f967555200c111925d48a46b65b124432a762b65/research/no-edge-asymmetric-block-link/README.md), and the fiber context in [PR #5921](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5921). @unpaidmoon supplied the odd-fresh square family in [PR #7281](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7281), [exact proof](https://github.com/unpaidmoon/integer-mult-bounds/blob/0cd5324c41490b856d0e94daa8b011683fc153f6/research/no-edge-dim5-fresh-link/PROOF.md), the seven-projector model in [PR #7237](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/7237), and the normal-form triple in [PR #6921](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6921). The special base-pool calculation is derived again here; no predecessor code was copied. New work is Apache-2.0.

A zero fresh factor, multiple links and arbitrary five-dimensional pattern spaces are outside the theorem. The next structural question is whether a seven-dimensional irreducible image can avoid two disjoint normal-form blocks. A paid word, native operator, precision/range contract, physical supplier and complete invoice remain separate obligations. Base: canonical main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`, priority revision 8. Live open/closed PR and Discussion overlap was checked; sparse local notes and unpublished work remain coverage limits.
